explanation: Two bodies start at rest 1.41 apart with masses 1 and 20, G=5, dt=max. After 1 outer step (9 substeps) light body vx=-1.117 and heavy body vx=+0.0503, giving net px=-0.112 per axis, |p|~0.158 vs allowed 0.004. Impulses m*dv are -1.117 vs +1.005, not equal-opposite, so pairwise forces were not antisymmetric over the step. Likely cause is per-body adaptive substepping / velocity- or acceleration-dependent splitting breaking Newton's third law symmetry.
